title: Build a multi-agent orchestration layer in 2 minutes
description: Everyone overcomplicates multi-agent setups. The orchestration layer really comes down to a few pieces. A shared database for tasks and messages. An agents.md that loads identity, your profile, and guardrails into every agent the second it boots. A heartbeat to keep them alive. A shared vector knowledge base every agent can search. And skills that teach each agent how to use all of it. Put Telegram polling on top and you run the whole thing from your phone. I already built the plug and play version and 60+ of my community members are running it in their own business. Link in bio.
